title: Main draft implementation: federated user mention textual form
description:
Implement the design decisions from jmap-chat-spec-f13f.1 in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md for federated user mentions.

Blocked on jmap-chat-spec-f13f.1.

Likely scope (depends on Decision 2 from f13f.1):
- Clarify the value-space of the Mention type's `id` field (or equivalent) to explicitly permit federated handles like `alice@example.com`
- Update the existing rich-body example at draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md:1296 (which already shows `userId: "user:alice@example.com"` — confirm or refine this convention)
- Specify how client implementations resolve textual `@user@host` strings to Mention entries at compose time (if anything specified at all — recommended is to leave client-side, with the structured-mention pattern doing the work)
- Update server-side validation rules for federated mention identifiers
- Document interaction with the ChatContact-creation rules — does a federated mention create a ChatContact eagerly?

Does NOT include: federation draft (Peer/deliver) updates — separate bead.
acceptance_criteria:
- Mention identifier value-space for federated form documented
- Rich-body example updated if needed
- Client-side resolution guidance is consistent with the structured-mention pattern (or explicitly different, if Decision 3 went that way)
- Server-side validation rules are clear about what counts as a valid federated mention identifier
- ChatContact-creation interaction documented
close_reason: Implementation covered by one-paragraph prose addition to the Mention section (commit forthcoming). Existing rich-body example at line 1307 already shows federated form; no example update needed.
